answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond that vests slowly, like a glacier, before it can transact. Newcomers start on low ground, a knoll of limited trust, and earn higher limits only through sustained honest work attested by peers. A tide of fresh fake identities therefore costs the attacker a real bond per identity, and any detected fraud slashes the bond, so flooding the market scales cost linearly while honest agents pay nothing beyond the temporary lock.
